signalPolicy: Only the Popen child created with start_new_session=True supplies the process-group id. Never substitute a queried or caller-supplied group. ESRCH closes that id permanently. TERM then bounded group observation/KILL independent of shell-leader status; only own leader reaped before probes. Temporary SIGTERM handler records during spawn/cleanup, raises on first active-monitor cancellation, ignores no signals silently and restores previous handler. Default SIGINT remains caught as KeyboardInterrupt.
statusPolicy: Raw child code is separate from launcher status. Monitor/cleanup/external cancellation/errors are finalized; missing final observation or result storage makes evidence incomplete/nonzero; stdout retains full result even on simulated ENOSPC.
retainedCounterexamples: launcher-v4-history/before-sigterm-review preserves original source4checks before Root cancellation review
launcher-v4-history/before-reap-observation-review preserves6checks with recorded EPERM after KILL; source now reaps own leader before group probe; new6checks require cleanup.errors empty
limits: Source review and benign lifecycle checks are not native build/runtime acceptance
Capacity precondition/1s sampling do not guarantee no transient ENOSPC
Cleanup is bounded; any unconfirmed group exit or reap is reported incomplete and fails launcher
Known group identities are used only in their immediate owned lifecycle; not a general hostile process/PID-churn service
Future repeatedGC retry needs a fresh approved namespace because the fixed GC no-tag identity cannot be reused
Partial new launch/result/log files are preserved, never overwritten
